title: TimelineXray command-line JSON envelope
description: The one object every `txray ... --json` invocation prints, whatever happens: a result (outcome ok; attention or failed for commands that report a result and exit 1) with data and warnings, or an error (outcome error, exit code 1, 2, 3 or 130) with error.code and error.message, data null and warnings empty. Usage errors (code usage, exit 2) and unexpected exceptions (code internal_error, exit 1; the traceback goes to stderr) use the same error form. Keys are sorted and the output is ASCII. The one exception is `txray mcp tools --json`, which prints the MCP tools/list definitions themselves.

version.description: The txray version that produced the envelope.

command.description: The command as named on the command line (`show`, `findings add`, `metrics import`); null only for a usage error before a command was identified.

data.description: The command's result (an object; its members are documented per command), or null on an error.

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings; empty on an error.

error.description: Present and an object only when outcome is error.

note.description: The public-default footer of commands that show numbers from upstream code (boundary 5).

code.description: A stable machine-readable code: the exception's code (error, invalid_input, network_refused, git_error, not_found, refused, integrity_error, span_range, plus the analytics and MCP codes offline_violation, write_refused, export_rejected, dataset_error and time_budget_exceeded), os_error, usage, interrupted or internal_error.

message.description: One human-readable sentence; untrusted upstream text is escaped.
